benji: Quick heads-up: p99 latency spike in eu-west1 for text-gen endpoints (observed ~420ms vs baseline ~260ms). Suspect the tokenizer tweak landed in v2.1.4. Proposal: pin clients to v2.1.3 for eu-west1 and run a staggered canary rollout with a 30m guard window. Need expedited approval from releases + SRE to use the maintenance slot. @oncall-sre can you watch?

deploy-bot: roll action created: rollout-id rr-91234. Pipeline: canary(5%) -> 25% -> 100%. Artifact: redwood-tiny:v2.1.3 @ sha256:abcdef123456. Details: https://ci.redwood.internal/rolls/rr-91234

alice: +1 to pin and canary. Two asks before we proceed: 1) add automated rollback triggers (p95 > 350ms OR error-rate > 0.5%) and 2) include a short regression note for release notes. Otherwise :thumbsup:

ciara: Approved for expedited window from releases side. I'll be on call to watch telemetry during the 30m. Recommend starting at 5% canary then 25%. Prefer auto-rollback on the triggers alice mentioned.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I'll spin up a temporary alert runbook and open a trace investigation. Rollback criteria we'll enforce: sustained p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR 5xx increase > 2x baseline. If triggered, pin back to v2.1.2 and abort rollout. Also ensure KV-cache preservation on node swap so cold-starts don't skew metrics.

benji: Command I'll invoke to start the rollout (using ri CLI):
```bash
ri rollout start \ 
  --model redwood-tiny:v2.1.3 \ 
  --region eu-west1 \ 
  --canary 5 \ 
  --stages 25,100 \ 
  --window 30m \ 
  --rollback-p95 350 \ 
  --rollback-error-rate 0.5
```

deploy-bot: rollout rr-91234: canary stage started at 1812345730, target=5% traffic. Metrics streaming: https://metrics.redwood.internal/rr-91234

product-ops: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note to send if we reach 100%. Ping me if we hit the rollback triggers so I don't send incorrect messaging.

deploy-bot: rollout rr-91234: canary metric check OK at +5m. Promoting to 25% at 1812345760.

oncall-sre: I see slight p99 improvement and p95 ~330ms (close to threshold). No rollback yet. I'm annotating traces for tokenization-heavy requests to see if there's a hot path.

ciara: Good to proceed — if the next 10m looks stable, approve go to 100%. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollout rr-91234: promoted to 100% at 1812345775. Finalizing... SUCCESS. Model redwood-tiny:v2.1.3 pinned in region eu-west1.

benji: Thanks all — closing the expedited window. I'll file a small changelog PR with the regression notes and the enforced rollback policy. Will also attach traces and metric snapshots. :tada:
